==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(in front of the Nexus)
:'''Marcus:''' Hail Imperator, I wish to confess...
:'''Marcus:''' I... accepted a [[Fisalia Family|Fisalia]] deal... deceiving a [[Montelli Family|Montelli]] alongside him.
:'''Marcus:''' I only wanted an "elixir" to save my beloved Lanishi.
:'''Marcus:''' Forgive me, Imperator.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(at Margherita)
:'''Marcus:''' Please keep your Echoes down, gentlemen, and avoid causing unnecessary disturbances in the restaurant.
:'''Marcus:''' Would you like to put away your Echoes, or should I bring each of them a dish to match yours?
:{{DIcon}} Do they do this often?
:'''Marcus:''' I've gotten used to it...
:'''Marcus:''' [[Margherita|Ms. Margherita]] won't step in as long as they don't disrupt other guests from enjoying their meals.
:'''Marcus:''' But, honestly, I'd really prefer if they could take their arguments somewhere else.
{{Dialogue End}}
